main.description: Public Fund grant proposal. Anyone (Adherent or external) can submit. Per ADR-2605192145 §2. Quorum 20% active SBTs, approval 50% of cast votes, 48h timelock.

missionAxisHash.description: Mission Charter axis this proposal serves. Required for LLM evaluation + Council deliberation.

recipients.description: 0x-prefixed recipient addresses. None can be Charter Non-Aligned (checked at propose() time).

amounts.description: USDC base units per recipient. Parallel to recipients.

evidenceCid.description: IPFS CID of full proposal document (markdown / PDF).

milestonesCid.description: Optional IPFS CID of milestone breakdown if using MilestoneEscrow path.

proposalBondTxHash.description: Tx hash of the minimum proposal bond (spam prevention).

onchainProposalId.description: PublicFundGovernance contract proposalId (set after propose() tx).
